See e.g. [Sakata Eio vs. Sugiuchi Masao (1956)](ps.waltheri.net/database/game/20200).

Although this is an old variation, it is somehow modern (thanks in no small part to AlphaGo) and more likely to be played by today's professionals if only the empty triangle at <A:Q15> led to a good result (it does not).
